title: Observability: algo-not-found in non-FIPS mode logs at pr_debug — invisible in production
description: ioctl_init() in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c lines 628-630: when no provider is registered for a requested algorithm and no FIPS provider is loaded, the failure is logged at pr_debug level. In production kernels, dynamic debug is disabled by default, so this message is invisible. A support engineer investigating -ENOENT from INIT in a non-FIPS deployment sees nothing in dmesg. The symmetric case (FIPS provider loaded) correctly uses pr_info_ratelimited at line 625. Fix: raise the non-FIPS-mode case from pr_debug to pr_info_ratelimited to match the existing FIPS-mode log level, so both cases are visible without dynamic debug.
